explainer_content.short_definition: Metal accelerated into tight, aggressive, riff-driven velocity.
explainer_content.history_capsule: Thrash took traditional metal's technical force and pushed it into faster, sharper underground forms in the 1980s.
explainer_content.why_it_mattered: It became the major bridge from classic metal to extreme metal while still producing mainstream landmarks.
explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: The sound is defined by riff motion, tempo, and precision more than pop hooks or blues swing.
